_comment: Named, self-defined item sets for select_tracked.py, referenced by presets in presets.json. Each set is a list of item ids; an optional 'cron_table' assigns those items to an ETL cron table (default 'a'), applied as a cross-cutting override so the items keep that assignment no matter which preset selects them (e.g. the Deboreka series stays on table 'b' even when picked via the broad 'accessories' preset).
